central_problem: metadata resolution success、payload bytes、parser output 與 qualifying full text 如何不再被混成一個 success？
reader_takeaway: 沒有 identity-matched、materialized、semantically qualifying artifact，就不能把 metadata 或 abstract 升格成全文。

known_at_the_time.fact: full-text recovery source separates legal route planning, payload validation, format dispatch, identity validation and canonical qualification。
fresh qualifying-full-text case coverage was 2/10 and HTTP 200 alone was explicitly insufficient。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: JATS/HTML/PDF/OCR routes, MIME/magic-byte checks, structural qualification and canonical admission were kept as separate stages。

not_yet_available.fact: 2/10 qualifying coverage remained below the >=8/10 readiness threshold; this was not a Writer problem to solve by prompt changes。

observed_failures.symptom: OA/DOI metadata resolution could be recorded as success even when no usable document artifact existed
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: artifactCreated and metadata lookup had previously been conflated; JATS/PDF/MIME/identity edges were under-specified
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: abstract, landing, wrong article and policy failures must remain non-qualifying
observed_failures.later_resolution: qualification owner and acquisition telemetry separated resolution from materialization

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: The fresh full-text recovery V1 cohort qualified 2/10 cases; metadata or HTTP success was not counted as qualifying content.
tests_and_metrics.result: full-text threshold remained the weak layer

engineering_decisions.decision: 讓 bytes、format、identity、structure、parser and admission each produce auditable evidence before qualification。

architecture_state.state: candidate study → legal route → payload → format/parser → qualifying artifact → canonical admission

safe_public_facts.fact: HTTP 200 只表示一次 HTTP response 成功，不表示拿到正確、完整、可引用的研究全文。

retrospective_notes.note: 後來 OA V2 與 V6A 又把 format-aware identity/materialization 綁得更嚴格；本日不宣稱 acquisition 已 ready。

publication_risks: 不能公開未授權全文或 private route。
不能把 metadata resolution count 當 qualifying full-text count。
